setting: ONE engine instance, built once by DiffGenerator.from_pretrained(model_path=<the staged SD3-medium>, num_gpus=1). After each op the SAME fixtures are generated in the same order (their prompt, seed, steps, guidance and size from tests/sd3_golden.json), so two requests may differ only by the adapter state they were served under.

api.set: DiffGenerator.set_lora(<adapter nickname>, lora_path=<its safetensors file>, strength=<scale>)
api.disable: DiffGenerator.unmerge_lora_weights()  -- the pinned engine documents it as 'unmerge LoRA weights from the base model; this also disables LoRA'
api.scale: DiffGenerator.set_lora(<the active adapter>, lora_path=<its file>, strength=<scale>)
api.why_these: Exercise set_lora for adapter selection and strength, and unmerge_lora_weights for disabling adapters. merge_lora_weights(strength=...) is outside this request sequence.
api.multi: DiffGenerator.set_lora([<nick>, ...], lora_path=[<file>, ...], strength=[<scale>, ...]) -- several adapters active at once, each at its own scale
api.refuse: an op marked refused must raise before any weight changes; the previous state stays active

ops.why: r0: the base model, before any adapter is ever loaded
r1: the same again -- the engine's own repeat noise, the level the equal pairs are judged at
r3: B REPLACES A; A\B modules must be back to base, B\A modules gain B
r4: disabled after two different adapters: must be the base model again
r5: A again: must reproduce r2 (no residue from B or from the disable)
r6: A at scale 0 is the base model
r7: A at half scale, judged against the merged reference at scale 0.5 (the delta is linear in scale, the output is not)
r8: rsLoRA C (r 16, alpha 16): scale * alpha / sqrt(r) = 4 * B @ A; an engine reading alpha / r serves a quarter (the rslora_ignored neighbour)
r9: a DoRA file: set_lora must raise before any weight changes; C stays active, so r9 equals r8
r10: a LoRA-bias file, refused likewise; after two refusals C is still served exactly (r10 equals r8)
r11: alpha_pattern E: to_q / to_k / to_v at alpha 32, the rest at 8 (r 8); dropping the pattern serves those modules at a quarter (the pattern_ignored neighbour)

r12: A at 1 and C at 0.5 at once: every linear computes W + 1 * (16/8) * B_A @ A_A + 0.5 * (16/sqrt(16)) * B_C @ A_C, each adapter with its own scaling. first_at_last_scale and last_only are incorrect alternatives.
r13: the same request again must equal r12; setting the same adapter configuration twice must not accumulate duplicate entries.
r14: disabled after all of that: the base model again (equals r4)

reading_points.what: the served DiT's forward at the n-th DISTINCT timestep of a request (step index, 0-based), every pass at that step (a CFG request may run its two branches as separate passes or as one batch; both are read)
reading_points.why: Sample early and middle denoising steps against the independent reference. Step 27 is diagnostic because late-step numerical variation can obscure the adapter effect.

judgement.reference_agreement: lora_reference_verdict pools each request's reading points against diffusers' SD3Transformer2DModel in float32 on the candidate's captured inputs. Weights W + scale * (alpha / r) * B @ A are merged in float64 for base, X@s/2, X@s and X@2s. The nearest grid state is the served state. Margin compares the intended-state distance with the nearest distinguishable neighbour; C normalizes by a bf16 replay with the same merged weights rounded once. Pass requires the intended state, margin <= margin_max, and C <= floor_ratio_max x max(1, C of the first base request). Policy constants are in day0_policy.py; this LoRA analysis is experimental and excluded from the task score.
judgement.discriminates: A grid neighbour enters the margin only where the bf16 legal port distinguishes it within power_margin; the argmin uses the whole grid. Per-point normalization by the candidate's own base-request error is diagnostic only because it can confound numerical error with the adapter effect.
judgement.state_isolation: each equal pair's final images, and its DiT outputs at step 0, must be as close as the repeat pair: bit-identical if the repeat pair is. Equal pairs are served on the same forward path (both after an adapter was first loaded); a cross-regime pair (the base model before any adapter vs after unmerge) is recorded with its rel_l2 and judged only by reference agreement, because an engine's LoRA wrapper may legally compute the base model with a different rounding (e.g. an unfused bias add)
judgement.signature: the served grid state per request (base / half / state / double) is the strength signature: alpha/r dropped serves half for A and double for B, a scale ignored serves double on A@0.5, a no-op serves base. beta is recorded per reading point as a diagnostic only -- a projection, not a strength estimate
judgement.v4: r8-r11 use lora_reference_agreement on the grid base / X@s/2 / X@s / X@2s plus each op's neighbours; a refused op that does not raise fails it. r12-r13 use lora_multi_adapter_composition on the grid base / state / first_only / last_only / first_at_last_scale, plus the equal pair [12, 13]. These LoRA analyses are experimental and excluded from the task score.

targeted_negatives.lora_api_unavailable: the pipeline accepts no adapter: every set_lora answers an error ('Lora is not enabled' at the pinned engine)
targeted_negatives.keys_unmapped: set_lora is accepted but no adapter key reaches a layer: every request is the base model
targeted_negatives.alpha_over_r_ignored: delta = scale * B@A: A at half its strength (r2, r5, r7), B at double (r3)
targeted_negatives.switch_leaks: setting B leaves A merged on the modules B does not target (r3), and the disable cannot remove it (r4 != r0)
targeted_negatives.transposed_delta / scale_ignored / conte: Reject a transposed low-rank delta through the independent component reference; detect ignored scale with the zero and half-scale requests, omitted context targets with the adapter reference, and lossy weight restoration with the repeated base requests.

v4.rslora_ignored: C served at alpha / r: r8-r10 read the rslora_ignored neighbour
v4.variant_served: a DoRA or LoRA-bias file served as plain LoRA: r9 / r10 do not raise and read off C@1
v4.multi_last_scale: r12 reads first_at_last_scale on the merge path

legal_variants: merged at set time with an exact snapshot restore (the pinned engine's default merged mode)
unmerged: base GEMM plus scale*(alpha/r)*(x@A^T)@B^T at run time
fused QKV with the q/k/v deltas stacked in the fused layout
LoRA arithmetic in bf16 or fp32
pairs_note: a pair is compared on the fixtures BOTH of its requests generate (v4's r8-r14 run astronaut_cfg1 only): [4, 14] on astronaut_cfg1; equal_pairs feed lora_state_isolation, multi_equal_pairs lora_multi_adapter_composition
